curriculum: C: same arithmetic distribution split into A/B negative-control labels

experiment: MINI Cells Experiment 023 — Online Nonparametric Trait Genesis

interpretation.scope: 023 tests online unknown-K structural genesis with a fixed shadow gradient sensor. It does not yet establish a purely local NCA sensing rule, rewiring, pruning, merging, or inference-time recruitment.
interpretation.success: A strong positive requires zero false genesis on STORY-only in all replicates, stable 1->2 genesis with two-domain functional identity in >=2/3, no 2->3 growth under the duplicate-arithmetic control in all replicates, and genuine 2->3 genesis with three-domain functional identity in >=2/3.

question: Can one TextNCA organism decide online when and how many persistent phenotype traits to create from an unlabeled gradient field under an explicit structural complexity cost?
